// diagnostic

L0532

This division always divides by zero

What

This division always divides by zero

Why

The divisor folds to 0 at compile time, so every run of this line stops with E3010 (divided by zero)

Fix

Divide by a value that can't be zero, or check the divisor and handle zero before dividing

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0532: tests/ui_lint/zero_divisor.warn.

 Fix: Divide by a value that can't be zero, or check the divisor and handle zero before dividing
